summary: Frontend testing completed for Clara Radio Show Planning Dashboard - all requested features verified working. Tested: (1) Team page avatar image using s3_url - avatars load correctly from API paths, (2) RDS Scheduler unified UI - has same rounded-xl container styling, station tabs, legend at bottom as main Calendar, (3) Content Calendar unified UI - has same rounded-xl container styling and legend at bottom, (4) Show Management multi-presenter selection - popover dropdown shows team members for selection, (5) Rundown Editor presenters display - shows 'Presenters:' label with presenter name after header, (6) Calendar page presenter display - sidebar shows presenter names with Users icon.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamSettingsPage.js line 401-405: Avatar img src correctly uses 'member.avatar.s3_url || fallback' pattern with key prop for re-render
RDSSchedulerPage.js: Uses same container styling 'bg-[#18181b] border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl' as CalendarPage, legend at bottom with 'border-t border-zinc-800'
ContentCalendarPage.js: Uses same container styling and has legend inside calendar container with 'border-t border-zinc-800' styling
ShowManagementPage.js: togglePresenter function correctly handles multi-select for default_presenter_ids array via Popover dropdown
RundownEditor.js lines 334-356: Presenters section displays correctly after header with Users icon and presenter name pills
CalendarPage.js lines 351-358: Sidebar shows presenters with Users icon and names when show.presenters has data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly: (1) Team Settings page loads with avatars using s3_url when available, (2) RDS Scheduler has unified UI matching main Calendar - rounded corners, legend at bottom, station tabs, (3) Content Calendar has unified UI - rounded corners, legend at bottom inside container, (4) Show Management allows multi-presenter selection via Popover dropdown showing team members, (5) Calendar sidebar shows presenters for shows with presenter assignments, (6) Rundown Editor shows 'Presenters:' section after header. Test show 'Backstage Radio' has presenter 'Yannick Gijbels' correctly displayed across Calendar, Show Detail, and Rundown views.

Team Page Avatar (s3_url).details: Avatar images load correctly from API paths. Code review confirmed img src uses s3_url with fallback and key prop for forced re-render.

RDS Scheduler Unified UI.details: Has same styling as main Calendar: bg-[#18181b], rounded-xl container, border-zinc-800, legend at bottom with 'Status:' label, station tabs (Radio MFY, Radio GRK).

Content Calendar Unified UI.details: Has same styling as main Calendar: bg-[#18181b], rounded-xl container, border-zinc-800, legend at bottom showing 'Published' and 'Scheduled' status dots.

Show Management Multi-Presenter Selectio.details: Add Title dialog shows 'Default Presenters' section with Popover dropdown. Clicking opens list of team members (Yannick Gijbels, Hadewig Weyen, Chiel van Gansewinkel, Eddy Thijs). Multi-select supported via togglePresenter function.

Rundown Editor Presenter Display.details: Rundown section shows 'Presenters:' label after header with presenter name pills. Backstage Radio show displays 'Yannick Gijbels' presenter correctly.

Calendar Sidebar Presenter Display.details: Calendar sidebar shows presenters with Users icon when selecting a show. Backstage Radio shows 'Yannick Gijbels' in the sidebar show card.
